events.continuity_hook: Continues the fall-break Gulf Coast planning after the family narrows the stay to St. Pete Beach but has not decided whether to pay more for walkable beach access.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the Friday-versus-Saturday flight plan with the beach-block hotel choice, then decide what to book or hold and what to verify with the property first.
events.scenario_brief: Maya's family is leaning toward keeping the St. Pete Beach weekend car-light, which makes the beach-block lodging option more attractive than the inland suite hotel. The Friday Atlanta-to-Tampa nonstop has become more expensive than the Saturday morning departure, but the Saturday option cuts a full beach evening from the trip. The Monday afternoon return still fits the school-night reset. The unresolved pieces are whether the extra Friday night is worth the higher total cost and whether the beach-block property can confirm the room setup, resort fees, and realistic breakfast options nearby.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the fall-break trip from comparison into booking after the family decides that the extra beach time is worth the higher Friday plan.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights and hotel, choose the best available seats, and note the arrival-transfer and breakfast details that still need a plan.
events.scenario_brief: The school calendar no longer has a Friday conflict, and Maya is ready to move ahead with the Friday afternoon Atlanta-to-Tampa nonstop, the Monday afternoon return, and the beach-block hotel. The hotel confirms a family-suitable room setup, but breakfast is not included and the cancellable rate expires soon. Seats are available together, though only one window seat is open in the preferred rows. The remaining decision is whether to arrange an airport transfer in advance or rely on rideshare after arrival.

events.continuity_hook: Final pre-trip check for the Gulf Coast fall-break weekend after flights and lodging are set.
events.interaction_goal: Create a concise family travel checklist covering flight timing, hotel arrival, seats, meals, weather backup plans, and the few last items to verify before departure.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the October 10 departure, Maya wants a final pass on the family beach weekend. The flights are booked, the Monday return remains in the afternoon, and the hotel is confirmed near the beach. She wants to review Atlanta airport timing, Tampa arrival logistics, hotel check-in timing, breakfast workarounds, pool and beach access, and whether any better adjacent or window seats have opened. A rainy stretch is possible on Sunday, so an indoor backup and a late-checkout request for Monday are still unresolved.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new conference-and-training work episode after the family beach weekend wraps up.
events.interaction_goal: Frame the Chicago training trip, identify workable flight windows and hotel areas, and list the details Maya needs from the organizer before routing anything for approval.
events.scenario_brief: After the fall-break trip, Maya receives notice that she will attend and help run a healthcare analytics training in Chicago from Monday, November 10 through Thursday, November 13. The sessions are expected to be at a downtown meeting center, but the organizer has not yet confirmed the exact address or whether Monday evening prep is mandatory. She needs Atlanta-area flights that avoid complicated connections, a Thursday return that does not leave too late, and a hotel with strong guest ratings that will not make early training mornings difficult. The open questions are the exact venue, the Monday arrival need, and the Thursday end time.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Chicago training trip after the venue is confirmed and the Monday arrival requirement becomes less restrictive.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the strongest flight-and-hotel combinations, call out the convenience versus breakfast tradeoff, and decide which package is best to send for approval.
events.scenario_brief: The organizer confirms a Loop meeting-center address and says Monday evening prep is optional, with the first required session starting Tuesday at 8:30 a.m. Maya is comparing a Monday afternoon Delta nonstop into O'Hare that reaches the hotel around dinner with a cheaper Midway option that lands later and adds more ground-time uncertainty. The official hotel block is attached to the meeting center and has strong recent ratings plus on-site dining, but breakfast is not included; a nearby suite-style hotel includes breakfast but is a longer walk and has mixed comments about elevator delays. Thursday's closing session is still listed as late morning without a firm finish.

events.continuity_hook: Keeps the Chicago training episode moving after approval, with the flight plan stable but the hotel choice changing because the block is no longer available.
events.interaction_goal: Select the best backup hotel, prepare a clear approval note on cost and commute tradeoffs, and identify any breakfast or dining details to verify before booking.
events.scenario_brief: Maya's manager approves the Monday afternoon nonstop and Thursday afternoon return, but the official Chicago hotel block sells out before she can complete the booking. Two backup hotels remain realistic: a highly rated business hotel a couple of blocks from the meeting center with an on-site restaurant and paid breakfast, and a suite property across the river with included breakfast and more room but a less convenient morning commute. The unresolved issue is whether the closer hotel's higher nightly rate will pass approval or whether she should choose the lower-rate suite option and plan for rideshares.
